description: Use a companion you hold with an agent you run anywhere, with your own keys. Step 1: returns the exact `message` the HOLDER's wallet signs (free, moves no funds, gives no one control of the NFT) to link the companion to your agent's wallet, with a fresh `nonce`. Tokyo Futuro never holds your agent's key. Then the agent calls lounge_link_submit.

agentWallet.description: The 0x wallet of the agent that will work as her (the one it signs in with).

companion.description: The companion's token id (a whole number).

name: lounge_link_prepare
